key_highlights: ASX treads water as RBA Governor Bullock's hawkish stance and higher-for-longer rate fears weigh on sentiment
Iron ore downside persists, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' with auction reality check; fuel price shock compounds cost-of-living pressure
Active WA/SA gold exploration (Platina, Broken Hill, Forrestania, Great Southern) signals small-cap materials opportunity
ASIC warns private credit investors may bail; Crispin Odey's fall highlights systemic risk in alternative credit
Super contributions surge >33% post-budget tax changes; new government-backed digital pension scheme proposed
Global tech rally (AMD $1T, semiconductors, Bitcoin) contrasts with cautious ASX; oil prices falling
China political instability (Xi ally expelled, cracks widening) adds geopolitical risk to commodity demand

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness persists; gold exploration active across WA/SA; rare earths (Dalaroo) and antimony-gold (Larvotto) emerging
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore; small-cap gold explorers (Platina, Broken Hill, Forrestania, Great Southern) attract speculative flows; Dalaroo rare earths play aligns with supply-chain diversification

sectors.trend: Hawkish RBA (Bullock) supports NIMs but housing stress threatens credit quality; ASIC private credit warning raises sector risk
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates but face rising NPL risk from Sydney housing 'bloodbath'; private credit exposure a concern

sectors.trend: Oil prices falling globally; diesel/petrol shock rising domestically; EV adoption accelerating
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX face margin pressure from falling crude; fuel cost shock pressures transport and consumer sectors; EV transition (headlines #66) a structural tailwind for utilities

sectors.trend: ADARx $1.74B US IPO signals global biotech appetite; NDIS funding failures highlight domestic policy gaps
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor; ADARx IPO may lift sentiment for ASX-listed biotech; NDIS inquest findings could drive policy reform

sectors.trend: Housing market correction (Sydney, auctions); fuel shock; airfares soaring; rental market disruption proposed
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rate sensitivity; WES.AX, WOW.AX face consumer squeeze; property auction cooling may stabilise residential REITs medium-term

sectors.trend: Global chip rally (AMD $1T); super contributions surge 33%; new digital pension scheme proposed
sectors.implications: ASX tech names limited but super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) benefit from inflows; digital pension scheme could reshape super industry long-term

key_themes: Higher-for-longer RBA policy (Bullock hawkish) as dominant macro theme
Iron ore structural downside vs. gold/rare earths exploration upcycle
Australian housing correction and cost-of-living crisis (fuel, airfares)
Super/pension reform: surging contributions + new digital pillar
Private credit and alternative investment risk (ASIC warning, Odey)
China political instability and global trade disruption (Trump tariffs, CBP crackdown)
Global tech/semiconductor strength vs. cautious ASX divergence

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate path – Bullock hawkish bias delays cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour rate-sensitive value; reduce REIT and growth exposure; hold quality dividend payers
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and rare earths exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL data; reduce residential REIT exposure; favour healthcare and staples
Review super fund and corporate exposure to private credit; ASIC enforcement signals sector stress

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical – China instability, US trade war
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from China-dependent revenue; monitor AUD/USD and commodity flows
Hedge transport and consumer exposure; favour EV-transition beneficiaries

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths explorers
opportunities.rationale: Active WA/SA drilling (10.72g/t Great Southern, Broken Hill sulphides, Dalaroo Greenland rare earths) signals discovery phase; iron ore weakness rotates capital into precious metals

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate quality dividend banks on rate-supportive NIMs
opportunities.rationale: Bullock hawkish stance extends high-rate environment; NIMs support earnings despite housing stress; CBA and NAB best positioned
33%+ surge in super contributions plus new digital pension pillar create structural inflows for fund managers and platform operators

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and thermal coal exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Persistent iron ore downside and China political risk cap commodity upside; oil falling pressures energy margins

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim residential REITs and rate-sensitive growth
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney housing 'bloodbath', auction cooling, and higher-for-longer rates pressure valuations and occupancy

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge private credit and alternative investment exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: ASIC warning and Odey collapse signal liquidity risk in illiquid credit; potential contagion to listed funds

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Bullock's hawkish RBA stance and iron ore weakness cap upside. Housing stress and fuel shock weigh on consumer and REITs. Gold explorers and banks provide relative strength. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a tight band with sector rotation dominating.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots to cuts by H2 2027. Structural super inflows, gold/rare earths discovery cycle, and EV transition support select sectors. Key risk: prolonged China slowdown or private credit contagion. ^AXJO could retest prior highs if rates ease and iron ore stabilises.
